terms.metaDescription: Terms of Service for the IRONSTACK fitness app.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1Body: By creating an account on IRONSTACK, you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the app.
terms.s2Body: You're responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for all activity under your account. You must provide a valid email address to register.
terms.s3Intro: IRONSTACK is a community platform built on trust — other users see your stats, compare progress with you, and rely on the leaderboard to reflect real effort. By using IRONSTACK, you agree to:
terms.s3Item1: Provide truthful information on your profile (real name/display name, bio, and any other details you share).
terms.s3Item2: Log honest, real workout data — the actual weights, reps, and sets you performed. Do not enter exaggerated, fabricated, or false lift numbers, personal records, or session data.
terms.s3Outro: We reserve the right to remove leaderboard entries, personal records, or content that appears fabricated, and to suspend or terminate accounts that repeatedly submit false information.
terms.s4Body: IRONSTACK, including the AI Coach feature, provides general fitness tracking and suggestions for informational purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or personalized coaching from a certified trainer or physician. Consult a doctor before beginning any new exercise program, especially if you have a pre-existing health condition. You use any workout suggestions at your own risk.
terms.s5Intro: When using messaging, friend requests, follows, or any social feature, you agree not to:
terms.s5Item1: Harass, threaten, or abuse other users.
terms.s5Item3: Send spam, unsolicited advertising, or malicious links.
terms.s5Item4: Attempt to access another user's account or data without permission.
terms.s5Outro: Violating this may result in suspension or termination of your account.
terms.s6Body: You retain ownership of the content you post (profile info, messages, etc.), but you grant IRONSTACK a license to store and display it as needed to operate the app (e.g., showing your stats to friends, displaying leaderboard entries).
terms.s7Body: We may suspend or terminate your account for violating these terms. You may delete your account at any time from Settings.
terms.s8Body: IRONSTACK is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any injury, loss, or damage resulting from your use of the app or reliance on any workout suggestions.
terms.s9Body: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the app after changes means you accept the updated Terms.
terms.s10Body: Questions about these Terms? Contact us at <email></email>.

privacy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy for the IRONSTACK fitness app.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Item1: Account info: email, display name, username, bio, avatar, preferred unit (kg/lb).
privacy.s1Item2: Fitness data: workout sessions, sets/reps/weights logged, personal records, training splits.
privacy.s1Item3: Social data: followers, friends, friend requests.
privacy.s1Item4: Messages: direct messages you send to other users.
privacy.s1Item5: AI Coach data: your conversations and insights generated by the AI Coach feature.
privacy.s1Item6: Device data: push notification subscription info (if you enable push notifications).
privacy.s2Item1: To operate core features: your dashboard, workout tracking, leaderboard, streaks, and social features.
privacy.s2Item2: To send notifications you've opted into (friend requests, messages, PR celebrations, etc. — configurable in Settings).
privacy.s2Item3: To generate AI Coach insights based on your training history.
privacy.s2Outro: We do not sell your personal data to third parties, and we do not use your data for advertising.
privacy.s3Item1: Your profile (name, username, avatar, stats you choose to show) is visible based on your Privacy settings.
privacy.s3Item2: Direct messages are only visible to you and the recipient.
privacy.s3Item3: You control who can follow you, send you friend requests, and message you from the Settings > Privacy page.
privacy.s4Body: Your data is stored securely using Supabase (PostgreSQL database with row-level security), which may host data outside Egypt. By using IRONSTACK, you consent to this data transfer for the purpose of providing the service.
privacy.s5Item1: Access and review your data through your profile and Settings.
privacy.s5Item2: Correct inaccurate information yourself in Settings.
privacy.s5Item3: Delete your account and associated data via Settings > Account.
privacy.s5Item4: Adjust notification and privacy preferences at any time.
privacy.s6Body: We retain your data as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, your personal data is removed except where retention is required for legal or security purposes.
privacy.s7Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We'll notify users of significant changes.
privacy.s8Body: Questions about your data? Contact us at <email></email>.

achievements.pageSubtitle: Every badge you can earn — unlocked ones glow gold, locked ones show what to chase next.
achievements.profileSubtitleSelf: Badges you've unlocked — drag order with the arrows so the best ones show first.
achievements.reorderHint: Use the arrows to choose which badges appear first on your public profile.
achievements.showcaseBody: Same order as your profile — use the arrows to change what friends see first.
achievements.emptyBodySelf: Train, hit PRs, and build streaks — badges land here automatically.
achievements.emptyBodyOther: This lifter hasn't unlocked any badges yet.
achievements.progressHint: Your progress across the full IronStack challenge catalog.

friendChallenges.title: Challenges
friendChallenges.subtitle: Challenge a friend to a lift target. Once they accept, the first real set that hits it wins — auto-detected.
friendChallenges.createBody: Friends only. Pick an exercise, weight, and reps — they accept, then either of you can claim the win in a workout.
friendChallenges.needFriends: Add a friend first — challenges are friends-only.
friendChallenges.emptyBody: Challenge a friend to put a number on the bar.

exercisePicker.emptyBody: Try a different search, clear muscle filters, or pick another category.

exerciseCatalog.title: Exercise library
exerciseCatalog.subtitle: {count} exercises with local thumbnails and animation GIFs.
exerciseCatalog.gifCaption: Animation GIF — the primary demonstration for this exercise.
exerciseCatalog.arabicFallback: Arabic instructions are not in this dataset. English is shown; every other supplied language is still available in the menu.
exerciseCatalog.mediaTerms: Exercise media © Gym visual. Review their terms at
exerciseCatalog.mediaNotMit: The GIFs and thumbnails are not MIT or public-domain. Do not remove watermarks or copyright marks.
exerciseCatalog.loadError: Could not load this exercise. Go back and try another.

homeWorkouts.title: Home Workouts
homeWorkouts.subtitle: {count} exercises from the library that you can do at home — bodyweight, bands, dumbbells, kettlebells, and other common home kit. Gym machines stay in the full library.
homeWorkouts.pageIntro: Create a home split, pick one you already saved, or start a program for your goal. {count} home-friendly moves from the same exercise library.
homeWorkouts.draftHint: Adding to {day} · {count, plural, one {# exercise} other {# exercises}} in your draft.
homeWorkouts.noDraftHint: Add to split saves into your current split draft. You can keep browsing here, then continue and save the split.
homeWorkouts.yourSplitsEmpty: No saved splits yet. Start a home program below or create your own.
homeWorkouts.goalsBody: Professional at-home plans built from the same exercise library. Pick a target, then start or save it like any other split.
homeWorkouts.libraryBody: Filter the catalog and add moves to a split you are creating.
homeWorkouts.adoptFailed: Could not save that home program. Try again.

homeFatLoss.name: Home Fat-Loss Engine
homeFatLoss.blurb: 4 days. Full-body circuits, short rest, and conditioning finishers you can do with bodyweight plus light home kit.

homeMuscleGain.name: Home Hypertrophy
homeMuscleGain.blurb: 4 days. Push / pull / legs plus an upper pump day using dumbbells, pull-ups, and floor work — no machines.

homeCombo.name: Home Strength + Shape
homeCombo.blurb: 4 days. Upper/lower mix: heavier compounds, then volume and a short metabolic finisher.

homeHybrid.name: Home Hybrid Athlete
homeHybrid.blurb: 5 days. Strength, kettlebell engine work, pulling, and athletic core — built for people who train at home and still want to perform.

tour.targetMissed: Couldn't highlight this spot — the section may still be loading or isn't visible on your account.
tour.targetMissedAction: Continue anyway or skip the tour.
tour.deferredBody: You have an active session. We won't interrupt it. Start the tour later from Settings, or begin now only if you're ready to leave this screen.

learnItems: Navigate with tabs and the ☰ menu
Get a split — manual, AI, or recommended
Start a session and review history
learnItemsPart1: Navigate with tabs and the menu
Get a split and start your first session
learnItemsPart2: Find AI Coach and Settings when you need them
intro.duration: We highlight each area on the real page — use Next to continue. This tour never starts a workout or changes your data.

homeHero.title: Your welcome panel
homeHero.lead: The highlighted area is your Home header — name, avatar, and profile link.
substeps: Your display name and @username appear here after onboarding.
Tap View full profile to edit bio, avatar, and public stats.
This panel stays at the top every time you return to Home.
homeHero.tip: Guest accounts see a simplified label instead of email.

homeShortcuts.title: Quick shortcuts
homeShortcuts.lead: Jump to any major section in one tap from this grid.
substeps: Workout — your splits and training hub.
History, PRs, and Achievements — progress at a glance.
AI Coach and Settings — available when signed in.
homeShortcuts.expected: A grid of tiles linking to Workout, Explore, History, and more.

navTabs.title: Bottom tab bar
navTabs.lead: On mobile, these tabs are your daily navigation.
substeps: Home · Workout · Messages · Challenges · Profile.
The active tab is highlighted in gold.
Messages and social features require a full account.
navTabs.tip: On desktop, tabs may hide — use the ☰ menu instead.

navMenu.title: Full app menu
navMenu.lead: Tap ☰ (top-left) to open every section — Exercises, Home Workouts, History, AI Coach, Settings, and Community.
navMenu.leadCoachMark: The ☰ menu lists every section — Exercises, History, Coach, Settings, and more.
substeps: The menu slides in from the left on all screen sizes.
Gold highlight shows your current page.
Close with ✕ or tap outside the sidebar.
navMenu.expected: The ☰ button in the top navigation bar.

workoutSplits.title: Your splits
workoutSplits.lead: Your saved training plans live in My Splits — tap this link on Train to open the full list.
workoutSplits.leadCoachMark: My Splits holds every program you've saved — tap here on Train to browse and manage them.
substeps: Each card shows days per week and focus area.
Tap a card to open the split and pick a training day.
Use My Splits to manage every saved program.
workoutSplits.expected: Manage your splits link on the Train tab.

splitRecommendations.title: Recommended splits
splitRecommendations.lead: Profile-based program suggestions live inside Create Split — tap this option to browse scored recommendations.
substeps: On Train, tap Create splits to open this choice screen.
Recommended splits shows programs scored from your goals, schedule, and equipment.
Preview days and exercises, then save one to My Splits.
splitRecommendations.expected: The Recommended splits card on the Create Split choice screen.

workoutCreate.title: Create a split
workoutCreate.lead: Pick how you want to build a program — all three paths start here.
substeps: Create yourself: manual builder with days and exercises.
Create with AI: describe your ideal program in plain language.
Recommended splits: profile-scored suggestions ready to save.
workoutCreate.tip: You need an internet connection to create or save splits.

exercisesSearch.title: Search & filters
exercisesSearch.lead: Find any movement in the library using search and filters.
substeps: Type a name — results update as you type.
Filter by category, equipment, muscle group, or sort order.
Browsing here is safe — it does not start a workout.
exercisesSearch.expected: Search bar and filter controls at the top of the page.

exercisesGrid.title: Exercise catalog
exercisesGrid.lead: Tap any exercise to open details — form tips and demo GIF included.
substeps: Scroll the list to explore the full catalog.
Open a card to read cues and watch the demo.
Add to Split appears when you're editing a plan.
exercisesGrid.expected: Scrollable list of exercise cards below the filters.

homeWorkouts.title: Home workouts
homeWorkouts.lead: Programs for bodyweight, bands, and dumbbells — separate from gym splits.
substeps: Browse home-friendly programs on this page.
Use Workout for barbell/machine gym plans.
Logging works the same once you start a home session.
homeWorkouts.note: Pick the right entry point: gym splits under Workout, home programs here.

sessionStart.title: Starting a session
sessionStart.lead: When you're ready to train, open a split → pick a day → tap Start workout.
substeps: During a session: log weight and reps per set, or skip.
Use Next exercise to move through your plan.
Tap Finish workout — volume and duration save to History.
Resume anytime from the Active workout banner on Home.
sessionStart.warning: If you already have an active session, the tour may defer so it won't interrupt you.
sessionStart.troubleshoot: Accidentally started? Finish or Discard from the session menu, then restart the tour from Settings.

history.title: Workout history
history.lead: Every finished session appears in this list.
substeps: Each row shows date, split name, and total volume.
Tap a row for full set details and duration.
New accounts see an empty list until the first workout is finished.
history.tip: History is read-only here — manage sessions from the detail view.

coach.title: AI Coach
coach.lead: Open chat for training questions, split ideas, and programming advice.
substeps: Tap Open Chat — type at the bottom of the screen.
Coach may suggest plans — you confirm before anything saves.
Insights from past sessions appear on this page too.
coach.note: Guest accounts may have limited Coach access.
prompts: Build me a 3-day push/pull/legs split for hypertrophy
What should I do if my bench press stalls?

coachAiActions.title: AI that takes action
coachAiActions.lead: Ask Coach to build a split, tweak your program, or plan your training — you confirm before anything saves.
substeps: Type at the bottom — Coach can propose splits and session tweaks.
Review action cards before accepting any change.
Nothing writes to your account until you tap confirm.
coachAiActions.expected: Chat composer fixed to the bottom of the screen.

settingsAppearance.title: Appearance & theme
settingsAppearance.lead: Personalize how IronStack looks and feels.
substeps: Choose Dark, Light, or System theme.
Change language (EN/AR) and units (kg/lb) in nearby sections.
Edit fitness profile to update goals and equipment.
settingsAppearance.expected: Theme picker with three options in the highlighted panel.

settingsTour.title: Settings hub
settingsTour.lead: Theme, language, offline mode, fitness profile, and Restart App Tour all live here.
substeps: Useful after updates or if you skipped the first time.
Won't start if you have an active workout — finish or defer first.
settingsTour.expected: Restart App Tour button in the highlighted section.

offlineMode.title: Train offline
offlineMode.lead: IronStack keeps cached splits and session logging on this device — finish workouts without signal and they sync when you're back online. AI Coach, Messages, Leaderboard, and creating splits need a connection.
substeps: Works offline: browse cached splits, start and finish sessions, log every set.
Needs a connection: AI Coach, Messages, Leaderboard, notifications, and create or edit splits.
The nav bar shows Offline or a sync queue when relevant.
offlineMode.expected: Offline & sync reference panel with two capability columns.

socialLeaderboard.title: Leaderboard
socialLeaderboard.lead: Compare streaks and best lifts with the whole IronStack community.
substeps: Switch between Streak and Best lift sorting at the top.
Your row is highlighted when you appear in the rankings.
Tap any athlete to open their public profile.
socialLeaderboard.expected: The full Leaderboard page with rankings and sort controls.
socialLeaderboard.tip: A compact leaderboard also appears on Home — this page is the full board.

socialCircle.title: Training circle
socialCircle.lead: See recent activity from people you train with — back on Home.
substeps: Friends' sessions and milestones appear in this feed.
If you have no friends yet, the Home leaderboard still shows nearby.
Add friends from Community or Messages.
socialCircle.expected: Training circle feed on Home, or the Home leaderboard as a fallback.

messages.title: Messages
messages.lead: Direct messages and group chats with training partners.
substeps: Open threads from the inbox list.
Start a new group chat with the + button.
Messages tab also lives in the bottom navigation.
messages.note: Guest accounts cannot access Messages — create a full account to unlock.

done.title: You're ready to train
done.lead: You've seen the essentials. Pick your first move below.
checklist: Get a split — manual, AI, or recommended
AI Coach and Settings when you need them
